learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge of the main transmission techniques and wireless connectivity models.
Knowledge of the characteristics of networking algorithms, with particular attention to energy efficiency and the design of wireless networks for the Internet of Things (IoT).

syllabus_topics: Communication Channels and Capacity Free space
Infrastructure-based wireless networks Wireless network architecture
Ad Hoc wireless networks Access protocols
Topology control: connectivity, coverage, distributed algorithms, energy efficiency

assessment_methods.method: Oral exam with questions on the topics covered in class

assessment_rules: The assessment method is an oral exam with questions on the topics covered in class to assess the student's level of knowledge. The grading is based on a final mark.
bibliography: Andrea Goldsmith, Wireless Communications, Cambridge University Press, 2005.
Carlo Fischione, An Introduction to Wireless Sensor Networks, Open Access KTH, 2014
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Elettronica E Biomedica (Electronics And Biomedical Engineering), classe L-8 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria dell'informazione
